# Graph operations · fn

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### fn.branch

Run only the chosen declared function and return its result.

Origin: toolkit.
The two literal function names select a shared input and result contract.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `whenTrue` | `string` | Required | {"literal":true} |
| Input | `whenFalse` | `string` | Required | {"literal":true} |
| Input | `condition` | `boolean` | Required |  |
| Input | `state` | `number` | Required | {"finite":true} |
| Output | `value` | `number` | — | {"finite":true} |
| Output | `taken` | `boolean` | — |  |

- Only the selected function runs. The taken output records the selected condition.

Guides: [guide](../function-control.md#branches-sequences-and-loops)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.branch --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.cast

Explicitly cast between finite numbers, signed safe integers, normalized scalars, and Booleans.

Origin: toolkit.
The node type selects the target. A literal from declares the source. Numeric narrowing to integer exposes rounding.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `a` | `number` | Required | {"finite":true} |
| Input | `from` | `string` | Required | {"choices":["number","integer","boolean","unitScalar"]} |
| Input | `rounding` | `string` | `"exact"` | {"choices":["exact","floor","ceil","round","trunc"]} |
| Output | `value` | `integer` | — | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true} |

- A nonzero numeric value becomes true. Boolean false and true become zero and one.
- Integer casts default to exact and enforce the signed safe-integer range. unitScalar casts enforce the normalized range.

Guides: [guide](../reusable-function-graphs.md#value-nodes), [guide](../vector-operations.md#explicit-casts)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.cast --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.color

Build RGB(A), read components or luminance, and mix colors in linear light.

Origin: toolkit.
Declare srgb or srgb-linear. A literal operation selects the color inputs and result.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `operation` | `string` | `"mix"` |  |
| Input | `a` | `srgb` | Required | display sRGB · {"lengths":[3,4],"min":0,"max":1} |
| Input | `b` | `srgb` | Required | display sRGB · {"lengths":[3,4],"min":0,"max":1} |
| Input | `t` | `unitScalar` | Required |  |
| Output | `value` | `srgb` | — | display sRGB · {"lengths":[3,4],"min":0,"max":1} |

- Mix interpolates associated color in linear light and returns straight RGB(A) in the declared color space.
- Alpha defaults to one when composing RGBA. Components and luminance return numbers.

Guides: [guide](../reusable-function-graphs.md#value-nodes)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.color --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.loop

Repeat a declared state function within a literal bound, with an optional continuation test.

Origin: toolkit.
The body function defines state and shared inputs. An optional continuation returns Boolean.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `initial` | `number` | Required | {"finite":true} |
| Input | `count` | `integer` | Required | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true,"min":0,"max":1024} |
| Input | `limit` | `integer` | `64` | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true,"min":1,"max":1024,"literal":true} |
| Input | `while` | `string` | `""` | {"literal":true} |
| Output | `value` | `number` | — | {"finite":true} |
| Output | `iterations` | `integer` | — | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true} |

- The count is checked against the literal limit. An optional continuation sees the current state and zero-based index before each iteration. The iterations port reports completed iterations.

Guides: [guide](../function-control.md#branches-sequences-and-loops)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.loop --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.math

Evaluate a named numeric function or arithmetic operation in a declared scalar type.

Origin: toolkit.
A literal operation selects operands. Node type is number or integer.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `operation` | `string` | `"add"` |  |
| Input | `a` | `integer` | Required | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true} |
| Input | `b` | `integer` | Required | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true} |
| Output | `value` | `integer` | — | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true} |

- Integer division truncates toward zero. Modulo returns a signed remainder.
- Trigonometry uses radians. Division and remainder reject a zero divisor. Invalid domains and overflows fail.

Guides: [guide](../reusable-function-graphs.md#value-nodes)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.math --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.sampleColor

Sample a typed color texture at explicit UVs and return straight linear sRGB RGBA.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `colorImage` | Required | {"layout":"Typed RGB or RGBA image"} |
| Input | `uv` | `vec2` | Required | normalized UV · {"dimensions":2,"finite":true,"origin":"top-left edge"} |
| Input | `filter` | `string` | `"image"` | {"choices":["image","nearest","linear"]} |
| Input | `wrapU` | `string` | `"image"` | {"choices":["image","clamp","wrap","mirror","transparent"]} |
| Input | `wrapV` | `string` | `"image"` | {"choices":["image","clamp","wrap","mirror","transparent"]} |
| Input | `mip` | `number` | `0` | mip levels · {"finite":true,"min":0} |
| Input | `mipFilter` | `string` | `"linear"` | {"choices":["nearest","linear"]} |
| Output | `value` | `srgb-linear` | — | linear sRGB · {"lengths":[3,4],"finite":true,"alpha":[0,1]} |

- Samples use top-left UVs and straight linear sRGB RGBA output. Filtering works in coverage-associated linear light.
- Explicit mip levels clamp to the available chain. Fractional levels blend unless mipFilter is nearest.

Guides: [guide](../function-texture-sampling.md), [guide](../reusable-function-graphs.md#value-nodes)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.sampleColor --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.sampleGray

Sample a typed unitless grayscale texture or mask at explicit UVs.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `grayImage` | Required | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Input | `uv` | `vec2` | Required | normalized UV · {"dimensions":2,"finite":true,"origin":"top-left edge"} |
| Input | `filter` | `string` | `"image"` | {"choices":["image","nearest","linear"]} |
| Input | `wrapU` | `string` | `"image"` | {"choices":["image","clamp","wrap","mirror","transparent"]} |
| Input | `wrapV` | `string` | `"image"` | {"choices":["image","clamp","wrap","mirror","transparent"]} |
| Input | `mip` | `number` | `0` | mip levels · {"finite":true,"min":0} |
| Input | `mipFilter` | `string` | `"linear"` | {"choices":["nearest","linear"]} |
| Output | `value` | `number` | — | {"finite":true} |

- Read a unitless one-channel data or mask texture. UNORM samples decode to unit values. Floating-point data retains signed and over-one values.
- Use explicit UVs and a numeric mip level. The same settings can be shared across several bound textures.

Guides: [guide](../function-texture-sampling.md), [guide](../reusable-function-graphs.md#value-nodes)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.sampleGray --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.system

Read the active position, size, time, seed, or typed context value.

Origin: toolkit.
A literal name selects the output type. Context reads also declare node type.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `name` | `string` | Required | {"choices":["position","size","time","seed","context"],"literal":true} |
| Output | `value` | `integer` | — | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true} |

- Position defaults to [0,0]. Size uses the effective material extent when available and otherwise defaults to [1,1]. Time is in seconds. Seed is the project seed.

Guides: [guide](../function-control.md#system-values)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.system --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.valueProcessor

Evaluate a uniform typed program once and expose its named non-image results.

Origin: toolkit.
A literal program defines typed uniform inputs and named value outputs.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `program` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object","format":"ink-studio/value-processor","version":1,"precision":"f32","literal":true} |
| Input | `requested` | `integer` | `139` | {"integer":true,"safe":true,"signed":true} |
| Output | `value` | `pixelCount` | — | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Output | `size` | `vec2` | — | {"dimensions":2,"finite":true} |

- A single uniform evaluation returns up to 16 named values.
- Use an i32 pixelCount port for derived dimensions, a unitScalar for a normalized score, or vec2 for a range.
- Shares the expressions, local scopes, and bounded control flow of the Pixel Processor. Time and seed are uniform.

Guides: [guide](../value-processor.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.valueProcessor --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.vector

Construct, swizzle, and operate on a declared two-, three-, or four-component vector.

Origin: toolkit.
The vector dimension and literal operation determine the ports. Specify operands for mixed arithmetic or append, and a literal pattern for swizzles.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `operation` | `string` | `"compose"` |  |
| Input | `a` | `vec4` | Required | {"dimensions":4,"finite":true} |
| Input | `pattern` | `string` | Required | {"minLength":1,"maxLength":4,"literal":true} |
| Output | `value` | `vec3` | — | {"dimensions":3,"finite":true} |

- Component indices start at zero. Swizzle uses one alphabet from xyzw, rgba, or stpq and returns a scalar or vector by length.
- Binary component math accepts two vectors of the same dimension or one vector and one scalar. Scalar position determines subtraction and division order.
- Cross product is available for vec3. Normalize, project and reflect reject a zero direction.

Guides: [guide](../reusable-function-graphs.md#value-nodes), [guide](../vector-operations.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.vector --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### fn.withSystem

Call a function with an explicit position, size and additional context values.

Origin: toolkit.
The called function defines its additional inputs and result.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `position` | `vec2` | Required | {"dimensions":2,"finite":true} |
| Input | `size` | `vec2` | Required | pixels · {"dimensions":2,"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Input | `context` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object","maxProperties":64} |
| Output | `value` | `vec2` | — | {"dimensions":2,"finite":true} |

- The supplied context extends the caller’s context for this call. Time and seed propagate from the enclosing evaluation.

Guides: [guide](../function-control.md#system-values)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe fn.withSystem --example > example.json`.
